facts.fact: According to eMarketer, private marketplace (PMP) spending by advertisers was $9 billion in 2018.
facts.quote: with $9 billion being spent by advertisers this year alone.

facts.fact: According to eMarketer, PMP spending is predicted to rise to nearly $13 billion.
facts.quote: The spend is predicted to rise to nearly $13 billion, accounting for almost 20% of total programmatic spending.

facts.fact: According to eMarketer, PMP spending is predicted to account for almost 20% of total programmatic spending.

facts.fact: According to eMarketer, Private Marketplaces have been rising steadily since 2016.
